statement.summary: Proposition 8.3 is frozen as five Props conjoined in `rankStatement`: the range claim of the definition (`rankRangeStatement`, rk_p ∈ {0,…,d}), one-step monotonicity for all primes p | n (`rankMonoStatement`), monotonicity along trajectories (`rankTrajStatement`), and two Lean-only well-definedness anchors of the definition of rk_p (`rankCardStatement`: |Stab(s) ∩ A[p]| = p^{rk_p(s)}; `rankIntrinsicStatement`: rk_p does not depend on the Lemma 3.3 isomorphism). The p-rank itself is the definition `rkP`: the F_p-dimension of the image of Stab(s) ∩ A[p] under the Lemma 3.3 isomorphism A[p] ≅ F_p^d.
deltas: rk_p = `rkP`: `Module.finrank (ZMod p)` of the F_p-submodule (`AddSubgroup.toZModSubmodule`) that is the image of Stab(s) ∩ A[p] under `latTorsionEquiv` (the Lemma 3.3 isomorphism A[p] ≅ F_p^d) — 'via Lemma 3.3' taken literally.

Two extra Props pin the definition down independently of that isomorphism: |Stab(s) ∩ A[p]| = p^{rk_p(s)}, and rk_p = finrank of Stab(s) ∩ A[p] with its own ZMod p-module structure. They are not paper claims.
'Prime p | n' = hypotheses `p.Prime`, `p ∣ n`; the proofs `hn : 2 ≤ n` are named because `rkP` needs n ≠ 0 (`by omega`).
'Non-decreasing along every trajectory' = `Monotone (k ↦ rk_p(Φ^[k] s))`; 'for all p | n simultaneously' = the prime is quantified after Φ and s are fixed.
Alphabet `Fin σ`; standing hypotheses n ≥ 2, d ≥ 1, σ ≥ 2 explicit.
